visualReview: Actual desktop closeup, overview and mobile inspected, followed by one art correction. Repeated round foliage masses replaced by sparse horizontal needle-group silhouettes with branch gaps; trunks/branches made more curved and tapered; arbitrary soil panels removed in favor of gullies, buried exposures and a root/stone seam. One floating ridge crown was connected. Limits remain: needle groups still read as designed graphic motifs, some bare branches are angular, some soil expanses remain flat, and the granite volumes remain stylized. The requested high art standard has NOT been judged met. Do not propagate this study as an approved standard to other stages/rest areas.
